newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek says to merge with Sisu.
newsitem.headline: Partek says to merge with Sisu.

text.p: Finnish cargo handling equipment and building materials group Partek Oy Ab said in a statement on Wednesday it would merge with state-owned Sisu Oy.
It said it would initially buy 19.9 million Sisu shares -- 53.8 percent of the company -- for 130 million markka in cash and issue 10 million shares to the state at 78.50 markka each.

Partek also said Norwegian Aker would sell its remaining 10 million shares in Partek to the state of Finland and receive in exchange 17.1 million shares in Sisu representing 46.2 percent of the company.
"According to plan, Partek will purchase Aker's Sisu shares during this year at FIM 46.03 per share plus interest accumulated to the date of transaction," it said.

As a result of the transactions, Partek's annual group net sales would rise to 12 billion markka and its core activities would be cargo-handling machines and equipment, forest machines, tractors and mineral based businesses, it said.
Partek's 1995 net sales were 6.5 billion markka and Sisu's net sales were 5.9 billion.

As a result of the merger transactions, the state of Finland would become Partek's biggest shareholder with a 30.4 percent stake and Finnish paper machine maker Valmet would be second largest with 10.5 percent of Partek.
Partek's present main owners Abo Akademi Foundation, Sampo and Elake-Varma would have 8.6 percent, 7.6 percent and 4.3 percent respectively.
"No new shareholder agreements will be made," it added.
"Sisu's 80 minority shareholders will be offered a redemption price of 47 markka per share," it said.
The government had approved the deal but the sale of Sisu would still require approval by parliament, it said.
Partek said the merger would make it the world's market leader in general cargo cranes, terminal tractors and mobile gantry cranes.

"Partek is already the market leader in Europe for timber cranes and demountable load-handling systems. In cut-to-length based forest machines, Sisu logging is the world's second largest producer," it said.
Sisu's Valmet tractors are the market leader in Scandinavia and the second most popular brand in South-America.

"The merger will make it possible to focus on the core business activities and their development. The company has a strong market position and growth potential in all its core businesses," Partek said.
"The products of Partek and Sisu complement each other," it added.
